title: Topology-Driven Multi-View Clustering via Tensorial Refined Sigmoid Rank Minimization

problem.claim: Multi-view clustering must exploit both intra-view topological structure and inter-view high-order correlations to cluster manifold data precisely.

gap.claim: Prior methods overlook intrinsic topological structure and shrink all tensor singular values equally, limiting manifold-aware clustering and discrimination of heterogeneous singular-value information.

contributions.claim: PANDA extracts view-specific topological structures from Euclidean graphs and integrates them into a low-rank three-dimensional tensor.
The framework uses a refined sigmoid function as a tighter surrogate for tensor rank to explore information associated with heterogeneous singular values.
PANDA merges topological structures into a weighted unified structure with a connectivity constraint to jointly leverage view divergence and explicit target-graph cluster structure.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that extensive experiments show PANDA outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

narrative_sequence.summary: Tensor-based multi-view clustering exploits high-order correlations across views.
Existing methods overlook intrinsic topology and treat all singular values equally during low-rank tensor recovery.
PANDA integrates view-specific topology into a low-rank tensor and applies refined sigmoid rank minimization.
Weighted topology integration with connectivity constraints leverages view divergence and explicit cluster structure.
The authors report superiority over state-of-the-art methods in extensive experiments.
